newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sen. Sarbanes criticizes Fed rate increase.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sen. Sarbanes criticizes Fed rate increase.

text.p: Senator Paul Sarbanes on Tuesday said he deplored the decision of the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, saying that such a move would unnecessarily hurt growth.
Speaking with reporters following the Fed action to increase the federal funds rate by one-quarter percentage point to 5.5 pct, the Maryland Democrat said there was no inflation to act against.
"There is no inflation to have a preemptive strike against," Sarbanes said, adding: "This is a preemptive strike against economic growth and against jobs."
